title: CY50105: Chemistry In Non-Aqueous Solvents
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NilProperties of some representative non-aqueous solvents,
including liquid ammonia, dinitrogen tetroxide, sulfur dioxide, molten salts,
room temperature ionic liquids, and supercritical fluids. Use of non-aqueous
solvents in synthesis. Books: J.E. Huheey
